---
title: "Lab 05 — Smoothing and splines in R"
output: learnr::tutorial
runtime: shiny_prerendered
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(splines)
library(mgcv)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("lab_submission.R")
mc <- read.csv("data/mcycle.csv")
x <- mc$times
y <- mc$accel
n <- nrow(mc)
cv_loess <- function(span, folds) {
  sse <- 0
  for (k in unique(folds)) {
    test <- folds == k
    m <- loess(accel ~ times, data = mc[!test, ], span = span, degree = 2,
               control = loess.control(surface = "direct"))
    sse <- sse + sum((mc$accel[test] - predict(m, mc[test, ]))^2)
  }
  sse / n
}
spans <- seq(0.15, 0.60, by = 0.025)
bbase <- function(x, xl = min(x) - 0.01, xr = max(x) + 0.01, nseg = 20, bdeg = 3) {
  dx <- (xr - xl) / nseg
  knots <- seq(xl - bdeg * dx, xr + bdeg * dx, by = dx)
  B <- splineDesign(knots, x, ord = bdeg + 1, outer.ok = TRUE)
  attr(B, "knots") <- knots
  B
}
B <- bbase(x)
D <- diff(diag(ncol(B)), differences = 2)
pspline <- function(lambda) {
  A <- crossprod(B) + lambda * crossprod(D)
  theta <- solve(A, crossprod(B, y))
  f <- drop(B %*% theta)
  edf <- sum(diag(solve(A, crossprod(B))))
  rss <- sum((y - f)^2)
  list(f = f, theta = drop(theta), edf = edf, rss = rss, gcv = n * rss / (n - edf)^2)
}
lab_meta <- list(id = "lab05", title = "Smoothing and splines in R", open = c("q9", "q10"))
lab_prompts <- c(
  q1 = "Among polynomial degrees 1 to 15 (fitted with poly()), AIC is smallest for degree…",
  q2 = "ksmooth(x, y, kernel = \"normal\", bandwidth = 5) uses a Gaussian kernel whose standard deviation h is about…",
  q3 = "With set.seed(2027) and shuffled 10-fold CV over spans 0.15, 0.175, …, 0.60, the chosen LOESS span is…",
  q4 = "Why does cross-validation with folds that follow the sorted times give a much larger CV error?",
  q5 = "Among ns(times, df) with df = 4, …, 15 inside lm(), AIC is smallest for df = …",
  q6 = "Your P-spline (20 segments, cubic, d = 2) with lambda chosen by GCV on the grid log10(lambda) = -3, -2.95, …, 6 has edf about…",
  q7 = "gam(accel ~ s(times, bs = \"ps\"), method = \"GCV.Cp\") has edf 9.7, less than your P-spline. Why?",
  q8 = "The residual standard deviation for 15 < times <= 40 divided by the one for times <= 15 (P-spline residuals) is about…",
  q9 = "The residuals are heteroscedastic. Name two consequences for the fitted P-spline: one for its confidence band and one for the choice of lambda.",
  q10 = "At about 12 effective df, the natural spline, smoothing spline, P-spline and LOESS fits are almost identical. Which would you report to a reader, and what single number makes the comparison fair?"
)
```

## What you will do

Compare polynomial, kernel, LOESS and spline smoothers on the motorcycle data, choose smoothing parameters by cross-validation and GCV, check a hand-coded P-spline against `mgcv`, and look at the residuals. The objects `mc`, `x`, `y`, `n`, `cv_loess()`, `spans`, `bbase()`, `B`, `D` and `pspline()` from `lab.qmd` are already loaded. Then download the `.txt`.

## Polynomials and kernels

Compute AIC for polynomial degrees 1 to 15.

```{r poly-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=4}
aic <- sapply(1:15, function(q) AIC(lm(accel ~ poly(times, q), data = mc)))
round(aic, 1)
which.min(aic)
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("12", correct = TRUE),
  answer("15"),
  answer("8"),
  answer("3"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("1.85 ms, because ksmooth puts the kernel quartiles at ±0.25 × bandwidth.", correct = TRUE),
  answer("5 ms: the bandwidth is the standard deviation."),
  answer("2.5 ms: the bandwidth is the full width of the kernel."),
  answer("1.25 ms: the bandwidth is four standard deviations."),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

## LOESS and cross-validation

Run the shuffled 10-fold cross-validation. Keep the seed.

```{r loess-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=5}
set.seed(2027)
folds <- sample(rep(1:10, length.out = n))
cv <- sapply(spans, cv_loess, folds = folds)
spans[which.min(cv)]
```

```{r q5}
)
```

Choose $\lambda$ for your P-spline by GCV.

```{r pspline-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=6}
loglam <- seq(-3, 6, by = 0.05)
gcv <- sapply(loglam, function(l) pspline(10^l)$gcv)
best <- loglam[which.min(gcv)]
ps <- pspline(10^best)
c(log10_lambda = best, edf = ps$edf, GCV = ps$gcv)
```

```{r q6}
  answer("9.7, the same as the default mgcv fit"),
```

```{r q7}
)
```

## Residuals

```{r resid-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=6}
loglam <- seq(-3, 6, by = 0.05)
best <- loglam[which.min(sapply(loglam, function(l) pspline(10^l)$gcv))]
r <- y - pspline(10^best)$f
sds <- tapply(r, cut(x, c(0, 15, 40, 60)), sd)
sds
sds[2] / sds[1]
```

```{r q8}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q8"]],
  answer("3.7: the noise is much larger during the impact than before it.", correct = TRUE),
  answer("1.0: the variance is constant."),
  answer("0.27: the noise is largest before 15 ms."),
  answer("13: the ratio of the variances."),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

## Submit

Type your name, download the text file, and upload it. Submit the questions first so the file contains your answers. If nothing downloads, the same `.txt` is in this folder: select it in the Files pane and choose Export.

```{r submit-ui, echo=FALSE}
shiny::textInput("student_name", "Your name", placeholder = "Name Surname")
shiny::downloadButton("download_txt", "Download submission .txt")
```

```{r submit-server, context="server"}
output$download_txt <- shiny::downloadHandler(
  filename = function() lab_submission_filename(input$student_name, lab_meta$id),
  content = function(file) {
    write_lab_submission(
      path = file,
      name = input$student_name,
      lab_id = lab_meta$id,
      lab_title = lab_meta$title,
      state = learnr::get_tutorial_state(),
      prompts = lab_prompts,
      open = lab_meta$open
    )
    # The viewer in Posit Cloud often blocks the browser download.
    file.copy(
      file,
      lab_submission_filename(input$student_name, lab_meta$id),
      overwrite = TRUE
    )
  }
)
```
